<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1/families/mine"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the family, all members with sharing state, the current user's sharing settings, and active location requests. Requires family membership. A member whose entitlement has lapsed still gets 200, with `lapsed: true` and a reduced payload carrying only the family name and the user's role — `members` and `location_requests` are omitted. A user who is neither entitled nor in a family gets 403.
